what: Revisions the owner decided for the current best model that reach its training rows only when a retrain builds a new instance. Each is already in force in the decided tables, so every Stage 0 build applies it and prediction runs read it at once; the model trains on it only from the next retrain, whose build must find it in the shared tables. src/pipeline/train.retrain() (the notebook's C0) runs every pending entry's check on the shared tables before it starts and refuses to start when one fails; src/eda/in_season_retrain/retrain.sh runs it again on the built instance before the fits, writes <instance>/revisions_at_build.json, stops when it fails, and marks the entries applied after a switch. src/eda/current_best_model/pending.py reads and checks this file.
owner_instruction: Ensure that when we implement the next re-train either through the master script or via another LLM agent, that it's aware of these intended revisions to the model, not simply adding the latest data. (the owner, 22 Oct 2026)
